utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to come by, but could you confirm the time and exact drop-off spot first? I just want to make sure I don’t show up at the wrong place.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure — I’ll check the time and exact drop-off spot, then let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, I appreciate it — I’ll wait for your update before heading over.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’ve only heard it’s still a rumor, with no confirmed date or details yet. I’ll ask around and let Kira and Faye know if I hear a start date or anything solid.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Tess — that’d be great. If you hear anything concrete, please pass it along and I’ll share the details with Pia and the others right away.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Of course — I’ll keep my ears open and let you know if anything solid comes up. Hopefully we get a real date soon!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yeah, I’ve heard it’s for small neighborhood fixes like squeaky doors and leaky faucets. If I learn anything more, I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Nell — that’d be a big help. I’m keeping folks split by task, so any extra details you hear will help me point people to the right spot.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sure thing — I’ll keep my ear out and share anything else I hear about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll keep everyone in the loop on the repair drive and repeat the plan as it comes together. Noah can count on me to pass along any updates.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Vik — I’ll swing by late and help sort the donations. I’ll leave the rest to Uli and keep it low-key.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll keep the plan moving and pass along any new updates to everyone.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I haven’t confirmed the repair drive yet, but if we need a ladder, Mina can bring one.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — I’ll keep an eye out on the block and send Rosa anything I spot that needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Bo — I’ll confirm the repair drive first, then we can see if Mina’s ladder is needed.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, then I’ll keep the repair list updated and coordinate the volunteers. Once Bo and Nell start passing along anything they hear, we’ll get those small fixes handled quickly.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, but do we have a confirmed date yet? And where exactly should people drop things off?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Not yet, but I’m pinning one down now. I’ll send the drop-off spot as soon as it’s confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds right to me — let’s start with the broken door and the leaky faucet this weekend, then handle the smaller fixes after.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — I’ll help sort the donations and label the boxes for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good plan, Sam. Let’s keep it tidy and start with the door and faucet this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Mina — I can help coordinate around the school schedule and figure out who does what once we know the start date.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sounds good — do we have a start date yet? If Hana says we need a ladder, I can bring one.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Not yet — Tess is asking around and will let me know as soon as she hears one. Once we have it, I can help line things up around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, I’m starting with the broken door and the leaky faucet, then I’ll get to the smaller fixes after that. Ira said they’ll check for updates while running errands and let us know when they’re back.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks — I’m keeping track of the repair drive item, and it’s still set for the porch at 14 Maple for drop-offs and pickups.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Great, that porch spot at 14 Maple should make things easy. I’ll keep working through the list and wait for Ira’s update when they’re back.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ll check for any updates while I’m out running errands and let Oren know when I’m back.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Ira — I’ll try to keep up with the updates too. Let me know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do — I’m heading out now and should check back after 2. I’ll let Oren know if I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks — I still need tape, spare screws, and any working wire for the repair drive. If Rey finds wire, that’d be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’ll make sure the connected neighbors get all the details, and Jules will pass along my info to a couple of them. I’ll keep an eye out for tape, spare screws, and any working wire too.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Mara — that helps a lot. If you spot any tape, spare screws, or working wire, please send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ve got my drill, hammer, wrench set, spare wrench set, duct tape, and ladder ready for the repair drive. Just tell me where you need me.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great — can you help Sam sort the donations and label the boxes first? After that, I’ll point you to the repairs.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I’ll help Sam sort the donations and label the boxes first, then I’m ready for the repairs.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll keep everyone in the loop and repeat the plan as it comes together. I’ll make sure Noah gets the updates, too.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Vik — that really helps. I’ll keep organizing the repair drive, and with you looping folks in, we should have a solid list soon.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll keep repeating the plan and pass along any updates as they come in. We’ll get everyone on the same page for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let’s start with the broken door and the leaky faucet this weekend, then we can handle the smaller fixes after. That keeps the repair drive simple and on track.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That sounds fine, but can you confirm the timing and where we’re dropping things off before I head over?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes — this weekend works, and I’ll keep the drop-off where we planned. If anything changes, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help, but I need to keep it low-key for now. Dane can swing by late and sort the donations, and I’ll handle the rest.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it — I’ll keep it low-key and pass along that it’s for neighborhood repairs. If I hear more details, I’ll share them.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Nell. That works for me—just keep it quiet, and I’ll take care of the rest.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, I’ll start with the broken door and the leaky faucet, then move on to the smaller fixes. Ira said they’d check for updates while running errands and let me know when they’re back.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, but can you confirm the timing and where we should drop things off? I’d rather have the details nailed down before anyone heads over.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’m a bit fuzzy on the exact timing, but I can confirm the drop-off spot once Ira gets back with the updates. For now, let’s plan on the usual place by the community shed.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ll ask Sam to sort the donations and label the boxes at the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Leo. I’ll look for tape and spare screws, and I still need a wrench set, duct tape, and a ladder if anyone has them.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, thanks. I’ll keep an eye out for the wrench set, duct tape, and a ladder.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’ve got the repair drive started, and I’m splitting folks by task so we can keep it moving. I’ll spread the word and connect anyone who wants to pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’m out running errands now, but I’ll check for updates and let Oren know when I’m back. Leo’s swinging by after 2, right?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yep, Leo’s coming by after 2. I’ll keep spreading the word and line up the task groups so everything’s ready when folks get back.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ve got a drill, hammer, spare wrench set, wrench set, duct tape, and a ladder ready for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’s great, Gus — I’ll make sure the connected neighbors have all the details. Jules is reaching out to a couple folks and passing along my info too.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Perfect — I’m ready when you need me, and I’ll bring everything over for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Mina — I’m keeping an eye on the supplies, and Rey’s checking for tape, spare screws, and any working wire. If anything turns up, I’ll make sure it gets to the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good. Let me know if Hana says we need the ladder, and I’ll ask Gus to bring his tools around 4.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Will do — I’ll let you know if Hana mentions the ladder. I’ll keep tracking the supplies and pass along anything Rey finds.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Bo’s using the porch at 14 Maple for the repair drive drop-offs and pickups. If the item moves, I’ll note exactly where it ends up.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, good to know—I’ll ask around and see if I can pin down a start date or any more details. If I hear anything solid, I’ll let Kira and Faye know.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Tess — I’ll keep tracking the drop-offs and pickups at 14 Maple, and I’ll note if the item moves anywhere else.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — I’ll keep an eye out for Vik’s updates about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, thanks. I’ll make sure Pia gets the repair drive details soon so she can decide, too.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, I appreciate it — I’ll watch for Vik’s updates and try not to miss anything.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help sort the donations and label the boxes for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That’d be a huge help, Sam—thank you. I can coordinate around the school schedule and help sort out who does what, and Tess will let me know as soon as we have a start date.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good—I’ll be ready to sort and label once you have the start date.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’ll swing by late and sort the donations. I’ll leave the rest to you, Uli.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it — I haven’t confirmed the repair drive yet, so I’ll check that first. And if we need a ladder, Mina said she can bring one.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — thanks, Hana. I’ll keep it low-key and focus on the donations when I get there.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
